title: Abstract Color Blocks
description: An abstract painting featuring large, overlapping blocks and vertical brushstrokes of vibrant color. The composition blends teal, emerald green, deep purple, orange, and lavender with visible texture and paint drips.
prompt: abstract painting with bold vertical and horizontal brushstrokes forming overlapping color blocks, featuring vibrant teal, emerald green, deep purple, bright orange, and soft lavender hues with visible texture, paint drips, and splatters on canvas, dynamic composition with strong color contrasts and expressive mark making
